summary: Iterated on debugging and finalizing a Svelte 5 refactor of the Composer/MessageList in apps/app. After re-running the targeted attachment test and adding debug logging that confirmed reactivity, the full app test suite passed (170/170), prettier and Svelte autofixer reported clean, and the conversation-feature files were left uncommitted.
errors: Targeted test 'attaches files from the composer and sends them with the prompt' initially failed with 'element could not be found in the document' on the 'Remove reference.png' button.
